# ZeroBounce

ZeroBounce is an email validation and deliverability platform that helps businesses improve email marketing performance by identifying and removing invalid or risky email addresses.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zerobounce/.

## Actions

- **AI Scoring Single Email** (read-only): Score a single email address using zerobounce ai.
- **Allow or Block List**: Manage allowlist and blocklist for email validation.
- **Batch Validate Emails**: Validate a batch of email addresses in real time.
- **Delete Email Finder File**: Delete a file that was submitted for bulk email finding.
- **Delete file**: Delete a file that was submitted for bulk validation.
- **Domain Search File Status**: Get the processing status of a file submitted for bulk domain search.
- **Domain Search Get File**: Download the results file for a completed bulk domain search job.
- **Domain Search Send File**: Upload a file for bulk domain search.
- **Domain Search Single**: Identify common email address formats for a given domain.
- **Email Finder File Status**: Get the processing status of a file submitted for bulk email finding.
- **Email Finder Send File**: Upload a file for bulk email finding.
- **Email Finder Single**: Find an email address for a given person and domain.
- **Get Activity Data**: Get activity data (opens, clicks, etc.) for a given email.
- **Get API Usage**: Retrieve api usage statistics for a given period.
- **Get Credit Balance**: Retrieve your current zerobounce email validation credit balance.
- **List Evaluator**: Evaluate the quality of an email list.
- **Send File**: Upload a file for bulk email validation.
- **Validate Email**: Validate a single email address in real time.
